children: Arthur Hayes received about $11.73 million in USDC from Galaxy Digital and Flowdesk, with about $6.96 million remaining to be accounted for. According to Odaily, Onchain Lens monitoring showed that Hayes (0x6cd...7e21) transferred about 8,000 ETH, valued at approximately $18.69 million, before receiving the USDC.

title: Arthur Hayes Receives $11.73 Million in USDC, With $6.96 Million Yet to Be Accounted For
